usage: “下個星期” (haa6 go3 sing1 kei4) is used to refer to the week following the current one.
It usually comes after time-related prepositions like “喺” (at) or “到” (until).
You can use it to plan or talk about future events or appointments happening in the next week.
It is often combined with days of the week to specify a particular day next week, e.g., 下個星期一 (haa6 go3 sing1 kei4 jat1) means next Monday.

examples.jyutping: ngo5 haa6 go3 sing1 kei4 jiu3 heoi3 leoi5 hang4
nei5 haa6 go3 sing1 kei4 dak1 m4 dak1 haan4?
haa6 go3 sing1 kei4 ngo5 dei6 jau5 haau2 si3
examples.meaning: We have an exam next week.

examples.jyutping: haa6 go3 sing1 kei4 jat1 ngo5 wui5 faan1 gung1
examples.meaning: I will go back to work next Monday.
